sentences.narration: Mia stands next to the brown horse and looks up at it. she is much shorter than the horse.

sentences.en: On a rainy spring day, Sara and Kofi study.
sentences.zh: 在一个下雨的春日，萨拉和科菲在学习。
sentences.narration: Sara and Kofi sit at a desk with books, rain on the window and spring blossoms outside.

sentences.en: They sit in the library of her university.
sentences.zh: 他们坐在她所在大学的图书馆里。
sentences.narration: Sara and Kofi at a long table in a large university library with tall bookshelves.

sentences.en: Sara learns the Spanish language at her college.
sentences.zh: 萨拉在她的学院学习西班牙语。
sentences.narration: Sara reads a textbook with a small Spanish flag on its cover.

sentences.en: She must describe a photo of her home.
sentences.zh: 她得描述一张她家的照片。
sentences.narration: Sara holds a photo of a small white house next to her open notebook, pencil in hand.

sentences.en: She writes a hundred words in her book.
sentences.zh: 她在本子上写了一百个词。
sentences.narration: Sara writes in a notebook filled with many lines of small wavy handwriting.

sentences.en: Sara makes a mistake and feels angry.
sentences.zh: 萨拉写错了，很生气。
sentences.narration: Sara frowns angrily at a crossed-out line in her notebook.

sentences.en: Kofi gives her his eraser with a smile.
sentences.zh: 科菲笑着把他的橡皮递给她。
sentences.narration: Kofi smiles and hands a pink eraser to Sara.

sentences.en: Then he helps her with his dictionary.
sentences.zh: 然后他用他的词典帮助她。
sentences.narration: Kofi opens a thick dictionary and shows a page to Sara.

sentences.en: Mia comes to Ben's house for his birthday.
sentences.zh: 米娅来本家给他过生日。
sentences.narration: Mia arrives at the door with a wrapped gift, Ben in a paper party hat welcoming her.

sentences.en: They wait for the cake at a garden table.
sentences.zh: 他们坐在花园的桌边等蛋糕。
sentences.narration: Ben and Mia sit at a small garden table with empty plates and forks, looking toward the house door.

sentences.en: Mia puts butter on warm bread for Ben.
sentences.zh: 米娅给本在热面包上抹黄油。
sentences.narration: Mia spreads butter on a slice of bread for Ben at the garden table.

sentences.en: Just then, a little pig comes near them.
sentences.zh: 就在这时，一只小猪走到他们身边。
sentences.narration: A small pink pig trots up close to the garden table where Ben and Mia sit.

sentences.en: The hungry animal finds a carrot under the table.
sentences.zh: 这只饿坏了的动物在桌子底下找到一根胡萝卜。
sentences.narration: A small pink pig sniffs an orange carrot on the grass under the garden table.

sentences.en: It eats all of the carrot very fast.
sentences.zh: 它飞快地把整根胡萝卜都吃光了。
sentences.narration: A small pink pig quickly munches the carrot, only the green top left on the grass.

sentences.en: Then it pulls the bread off Ben's plate.
sentences.zh: 接着它把本盘子里的面包拽走了。
sentences.narration: A small pink pig pulls a buttered slice of bread off the plate of Ben, who looks surprised.

sentences.en: Later, Ben closes the gate so it stays out.
sentences.zh: 后来，本关上了大门，让它待在外面。
sentences.narration: Ben closes the garden gate while a small pink pig stands outside it, Mia laughing.

sentences.en: Ben's grandfather invites him to his club.
sentences.zh: 本的爷爷邀请他去自己的俱乐部。
sentences.narration: Grandpa Joe holds the hand of Ben and waves him in at the door of a bright club room.

sentences.en: His grandfather has friends from many countries.
sentences.zh: 他的爷爷有来自许多国家的朋友。
sentences.narration: Grandpa Joe greets a group of friends of different looks in the club room, small flags of different countries on the tables, Ben watching.

sentences.en: An American woman smiles and waves at Ben.
sentences.zh: 一位美国女士微笑着向本挥手。
sentences.narration: A kind woman with a small American flag pin on her jacket smiles and waves at Ben.

sentences.en: Her son has a tiger on his shirt.
sentences.zh: 她的儿子穿着一件印着老虎的衬衫。
sentences.narration: A small boy beside the kind woman with the American flag pin wears a T-shirt with a big tiger picture.

sentences.en: A Russian man and his wife dance together.
sentences.zh: 一位俄罗斯男士和他的妻子一起跳舞。
sentences.narration: An older man and his wife dance together in the club room next to a table with a small Russian flag.

sentences.en: Ivan, a British police officer, tells a funny story.
sentences.zh: 伊万是一位英国警官，他讲了一个有趣的故事。
sentences.narration: Ivan tells a story with big gestures in the club room, Ben listening and grinning.

sentences.en: Everybody laughs and gives him a big smile.
sentences.zh: 每个人都笑了，并对他露出大大的笑容。
sentences.narration: Everyone in the club room laughs and smiles at Ivan, including Ben and Grandpa Joe.

sentences.en: Dan and his wife Anna are at a party.
sentences.zh: 丹和妻子安娜在参加一个聚会。
sentences.narration: Dan and his wife Anna arrive at a bright house party.

sentences.en: The house is busy and full of light.
sentences.zh: 屋子里很热闹，灯火通明。
sentences.narration: A crowded room with many bright lamps, Dan and Anna among the guests.

sentences.en: A lot of people talk and laugh inside.
sentences.zh: 里面有很多人在聊天说笑。
sentences.narration: Many guests stand in groups, talking and laughing in the bright room.

sentences.en: First, they look for a glass of wine.
sentences.zh: 首先，他们去找一杯葡萄酒。
sentences.narration: Dan and Anna look around the crowded room for drinks.

sentences.en: They find red wine on a long table.
sentences.zh: 他们在一张长桌上找到了红葡萄酒。
sentences.narration: Dan and Anna pick up glasses of red wine from a long table.

sentences.en: Dan says something personal into Anna's ear.
sentences.zh: 丹在安娜耳边说了些私密的话。
sentences.narration: Dan leans close and speaks quietly into the ear of Anna, near the garden door.

sentences.en: As they walk outside, the sky is cloudy.
sentences.zh: 他们走到外面时，天空阴沉沉的。
sentences.narration: Dan and Anna walk out into a garden under a grey cloudy sky.

sentences.en: Happy Anna runs to hug him by the flowers.
sentences.zh: 安娜高兴地在花丛边跑过去抱住他。
sentences.narration: Anna runs happily to hug Dan beside bright flowers in the garden.

sentences.en: Lily is at home with her grandmother.
sentences.zh: 莉莉和奶奶在家里。
sentences.narration: Lily and Grandma Rosa sit together on a sofa in a cosy living room.

sentences.en: A calendar with flowers is on the wall.
sentences.zh: 墙上挂着一本印着花的日历。
sentences.narration: A calendar of plain empty squares decorated with flower pictures hangs on a living room wall.

sentences.en: Lily draws a red circle around a date.
sentences.zh: 莉莉在一个日期上画了个红圈。
sentences.narration: Lily draws a red circle around one plain square on the flower calendar, Grandma Rosa watching.

sentences.en: The student needs new pants for her next trip.
sentences.zh: 这个学生下次出游需要新裤子。
sentences.narration: Lily holds up old pants against her legs that are far too short for her, looking at Grandma Rosa.

sentences.en: Grandma has some new pants on her arm.
sentences.zh: 奶奶手臂上搭着几条新裤子。
sentences.narration: Grandma Rosa holds a pair of blue pants and a pair of green pants over her arm.

sentences.en: Lily cannot decide which pair she likes more.
sentences.zh: 莉莉拿不定主意更喜欢哪一条。
sentences.narration: Lily looks back and forth between the blue pants and the green pants, a finger on her chin.

sentences.en: She goes to the toilet to try them on.
sentences.zh: 她走进洗手间去试穿这两条裤子。
sentences.narration: Lily carries the blue pants into a small bathroom with a toilet.

sentences.en: They are very long, but Grandma finds a way.
sentences.zh: 裤子太长了，但奶奶想到了办法。
sentences.narration: Lily wears blue pants that cover her feet while Grandma Rosa kneels and rolls up the legs.

sentences.en: Sara and Kofi visit a small bookstore.
sentences.zh: 萨拉和科菲去逛一家小书店。
sentences.narration: Sara and Kofi walk into a small cosy bookstore.

sentences.en: They see many young people reading there.
sentences.zh: 他们看到那里有很多年轻人在看书。
sentences.narration: Many young people read books between the shelves while Sara and Kofi look around.

sentences.en: Sara needs a book with horse photos.
sentences.zh: 萨拉需要一本有马的照片的书。
sentences.narration: Sara holds a book with a photo of a horse on its cover.

sentences.en: She read it at the library a week ago.
sentences.zh: 一个星期前她在图书馆读过这本书。
sentences.narration: In the bookstore, Sara holds up the horse book and points through the window at a library building across the street, Kofi listening.

sentences.en: Soon they are hungry, so they walk away.
sentences.zh: 很快他们饿了，于是就走了。
sentences.narration: Kofi rubs his stomach as he and Sara walk away from the bookstore.

sentences.en: At home, Kofi cooks fish for dinner.
sentences.zh: 回到家，科菲做鱼当晚饭。
sentences.narration: Kofi cooks fish in a pan in a home kitchen.

sentences.en: Sara puts a light over the dining-room table.
sentences.zh: 萨拉在餐厅的桌子上方挂了一盏灯。
sentences.narration: Sara hangs a lamp over a table in a dining room.

sentences.en: Then she puts a bowl of oranges on it.
sentences.zh: 然后她在上面放了一碗橙子。
sentences.narration: Sara puts a bowl of oranges on the dining room table under the lamp.

sentences.en: Ben and Mia go out in good weather.
sentences.zh: 天气很好，本和米娅出门了。
sentences.narration: Ben and Mia step out of a house into bright sunny weather.

sentences.en: Ben wears his new green shirt.
sentences.zh: 本穿着他的新绿衬衫。
sentences.narration: Ben proudly shows off his new green T-shirt.

sentences.en: They follow a path to the park.
sentences.zh: 他们沿着一条小路走到公园。
sentences.narration: Ben and Mia walk along a path into a green park.

sentences.en: Ben gives Mia a big bowl of salad.
sentences.zh: 本给了米娅一大碗沙拉。
sentences.narration: Ben hands a big bowl of green salad to Mia on the grass.

sentences.en: They both smile and eat the great salad.
sentences.zh: 他们俩都笑着吃这份很棒的沙拉。
sentences.narration: Ben and Mia smile and eat salad from the bowl, both giving a thumbs up.

sentences.en: They do not want to miss French class.
sentences.zh: 他们不想错过法语课。
sentences.narration: Mia looks at her watch and jumps up while Ben quickly packs the salad bowl.

sentences.en: So they run to the library behind the park.
sentences.zh: 于是他们跑向公园后面的图书馆。
sentences.narration: Ben and Mia run toward a library building behind the park trees.

sentences.en: Inside, they practise each French word twice.
sentences.zh: 在里面，他们把每个法语单词都练了两遍。
sentences.narration: Inside a library, Ben and Mia sit at a table and read aloud together from a book with a French flag on the cover.
